title: Security hardening (defect lane): shipped Layer-1/3 agent-context-integrity vulns from the Red Team wider eval — false-assurance dormant-vs-clean, forgeable-state envelope provenance, visible-prose injection in agent-consumed diagnostics

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
PHASE-4 ROUTING (route before fixing; operator triage = fix-now, defect lane). Three shipped agent-context-integrity vulns from the Red Team wider eval (#817), each with correct-artifact reasoning + the design control it seeds:
1. FORGEABLE-STATE ENVELOPE [blocking] — read_state validates only schema/shape; GateResult.evidence is a free string never resolved; derive emits next_action=enter-next-phase on a self-authored last_gate_result{result:pass}. Correct artifact: the derivation/machine form must not present a state-sourced gate verdict as verified. FIX now: mark phase/gate provenance as unverified-self-report in the machine envelope (and human form) until evidence resolves to a real boundary commit. Seeds controls REQ-2/REQ-4.
2. FALSE-ASSURANCE [substantive] — the report emits integrity_findings:[] when the finding/manifest/comment checks are DORMANT (inputs acquire empty until the Layer-6 join), read as checked-clean. FIX now: three-valued could-not-check — the report distinguishes checks-run-clean from checks-dormant (a checks-run vs checks-dormant manifest on the machine + human forms). Seeds control REQ-8.
3. PROSE-INJECTION [substantive] — clean_for_terminal strips invisible Unicode only; a hostile state.yaml key or git commit subject flows cleaned-but-intact into the agent-consumed broken-state diagnostic. FIX now: frame echoed external content as quoted-untrusted (a typed field the agent is told not to interpret as instruction), bound its length; keep the actionable branch on the enumerated kind. Seeds the visible-content companion to terminal-output-safety.
Sequence: fix 1 -> 3 -> 2 (blocking first; 2 is the most invasive). Red-gate each. v3 records these as the controls realized forms.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX 3 (prose-injection) DONE — commit 498eb526. broken.rs bounds the echoed quote (QUOTED_MAX 512 + worded truncation) and the machine form carries quoted_content_untrusted:true; actionable signal stays on the enumerated kind. Red-gate test broken_state_bounds_and_marks_untrusted_quoted_content (green; would have failed pre-fix). Workspace 0 failed, clippy clean. REMAINING: Fix 1 (forgeable-state envelope provenance — touches derive/PhaseAnswer, baseline-adjacent) and Fix 2 (false-assurance dormant-vs-clean — touches acquire/derive/report, the most invasive); both more control-shaped, to red-gate with care.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX 1 (forgeable-state envelope) DONE — commit 45068fd8. derive now returns GateProvenance on the gate-driven arms (2a/2b/2c advancement), marked unverified-self-report (read_state validates only shape; GateResult.evidence never resolved to a boundary -> a self-authored last_gate_result{pass} is a self-report, not verified). Machine envelope (gate_provenance key) + human form surface it. Red gate: convergence corpus now compares gate_provenance (faithful to 'every field by exact match'); 2a-red-recorded expects unverified-self-report (ORACLE REDLINE for operator adoption); non-vacuity verified (disabled -> left None right Some). Workspace green, clippy clean. REMAINING on #818: Fix 2 (dormant-vs-clean — deferred to Slice-1 2b, entangled with acquire). Owed: cold review (security+SE recorded dispatch).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX 1 COLD REVIEW (wf_79d280cb-234, security+SE, both REVISE) — routed, to address in a Fix-1 revise round: (1) SUBSTANTIVE: the security surfaces (machine gate_provenance key, human self-report line) + the 2b/2c driven arms are UNTESTED — a regression (drop driven() on 2b/2c, delete the machine key, flip the human cond) passes CI while reopening #817. FIX: status_red_gate.rs end-to-end assertions (machine+human surface provenance) + convergence fixtures for the 2b-green-pass and 2c-exit-pass driven arms (oracle additions). (2) SUBSTANTIVE: mod.rs doc over-claims a 'verified provenance ... added there' path that does NOT exist (one variant, no Verified, no mechanized path) — the over-claim reflex again. FIX: doc states only UnverifiedSelfReport exists, absence != verified, the load-bearing invariant (advancement token => provenance present); move 'verified' to a #815 forward-ref. (3) MINOR: human.rs hardcodes the string (is_some) -> machine/human divergence if Verified lands -> match the variant. (4) MINOR: machine added a security field without bumping vsdd_status_version -> bump/note. Revise round owed on #818.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX 1 COLD-REVIEW REVISE — committed 80872235 (workspace green in isolation; clippy clean). Addressed all four findings: (1) doc over-claim removed (mod.rs states only UnverifiedSelfReport exists, absence != verified, the load-bearing invariant; verified/mechanized gate forward-ref'd to #815 not claimed); (2) untested surfaces closed — status_red_gate end-to-end assertions on BOTH agent surfaces (machine key + human line, driven + non-driven) AND the 2b-green-recorded / 2c-exit-recorded convergence fixtures pinning the 2b/2c driven arms (count 22->24); (3) human form now an exhaustive match (future variant forces a new arm); (4) vsdd_status_version 0.1.0->0.1.1 as a documented security signal. NOTE: the 2b/2c expected answers are ORACLE REDLINES AWAITING OPERATOR ADOPTION (siblings of the 2a-red-recorded redline).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fix 2 (dormant-vs-clean, deferred to Slice-1 2b on this record) now has its RED-GATE PIN: build-plan Phase 1's falsifier set (vsdd-cli #820, draft PR #24) landed a_failed_finding_leg_with_tracker_present_must_not_pass_the_gate_vacuously — reproducing the exact false-assurance shape (failed finding leg -> snapshot indistinguishable from clean -> gate Pass). The fix builds as Phase-1 Unit C on that branch; this issue closes when the arm lands green + cold-reviewed per the Fix-1 precedent.
